author: Dr15Jones
body:
#### PR description:

The temporary objects used to handle the XML strings were deleted on the same line so the const char* obtained from them had already been freed. Now the object have the appropriate lifetime.

The problem was found by valgrind.

#### PR validation:

Running valgrind after the change no longer shows the problem.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52354
resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2491
title: Fix reading of deleted temporary in LHEReader
